{{RightTOC}} ==Description== '''Waves''' are the main event in the game that will become more challenging as the game progresses, introducing new [[enemies]]. Each mode has a unique set of waves, with some enemies being exclusive to that very mode. As each wave progresses, you get a wave completion reward, which depends on the mode you are playing. Players must make sure enough enemies do not reach the end of the path to reduce the base health to zero. Each player starts off with a set amount of cash. ==Waves== '''Waves''' begin by the following methods: #All enemies that spawned during the wave are eliminated. #:Enemies spawned by other enemies (such as the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] and [[Breaker2]]) do not count for wave completion in this manner. #:Other enemies from previous waves also do not count against wave completion in this manner. #The wave timer elapses. #All players, minus one, may vote to skip the current wave before all enemies are eliminated or the wave time has elapsedWith the exception of some event maps.. #:See below for timings. This, however, does not multiply the wave bonus by 1.1, instead, it makes the reduction per player weaker. This means that the actual wave bonus increase will in most often end up being higher than what the [[Skills|Skill]] lists as the increase. For example, in a quad match where each player adds a 10% reduction, a total value of 40%, Level 20 Stonks will change that 40% reduction to 30%. This boosts the wave bonus by around 16.67%, not 10%. Same method applies to modes like [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode, where there is always a 10% reduction per player, even in solo. If there is no reduction per player, Stonks will actually boost the wave bonus by the value stated. ===Wave Clear Bonus=== After a wave ends and every single enemy from that wave has been killed, a wave clear bonus is given. This wave clear bonus only appears in modes after [[Lunar Overture Event]], meaning it is currently only not present in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Wave clear bonus is a percentage of the wave bonus, with the percentage varying based on the player count. ===Wave and Skip Timer=== Once a specific amount of time has passed, a wave skip option will appear. This is a vote menu which lets the player to either vote for the current wave to be skipped or not. In solos, as there is only one person, voting to skip it will do it instantly, while the not skip option simply hides the UI. In duo or higher, all players but one need to vote for the wave to be skipped in order for the next wave to start early. Wave skip timer can appear at any time, though there are three main and consistent methods. The first is that they will appear after a third of the wave timer has passed. For example, if a wave is three minutes long, the skip option would appear after a minute. The second option is that it appears after 20 seconds have passed. The last option is it never appearing, which is generally reserved for infinite waves. Players can instantly skip waves if they have the VIP gamepass. ==Wave Structure== Each wave is pre-determined from the list below. This does not change depending on [[maps]], except for [[Polluted Wasteland]], [[Polluted Wasteland II]] and [[Badlands II]]. On multiple pathed maps (like [[Space City]] or [[Badlands]]), the [[enemies]] alternate between spawn points, however the enemy amount remains the same. This is, however, not true for multiple pathed maps with the [[All Paths]] modifier, which makes most enemies spawn on all paths.
